description: Loads the cockpit mod, injects the dforge entry point at session start, persists the session's transcript path for budget tooling, appends a compaction snapshot after compaction, runs darkmem's reconcile and pull at session start and pushes at each stop for a repository mapped to darkmem, and holds a stop once when a turn that advanced a plan, or ran a dforge skill and moved a branch without one, ends without the finishing menu or the next step, or up to three times in a row when an auto run's turn ends without its sentinel line.
